sets.context:
Runs scored and balls faced by four batsmen across three series (each series 5 matches):

| Batsman | S1 runs | S1 balls | S2 runs | S2 balls | S3 runs | S3 balls |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P | 240 | 200 | 180 | 200 | 300 | 250 |
| Q | 150 | 120 | 250 | 200 | 200 | 250 |
| R | 300 | 300 | 100 | 80 | 250 | 200 |
| S | 80 | 100 | 320 | 240 | 120 | 120 |

explanations: Incorrect. P managed 90.00 in S2 (180 off 200).
Incorrect. Q scored at 125.00 - joint second with R, not the best.
Incorrect. R also scored at 125.00 (100 off 80) - tied second.
Correct. S scored 320 off 240 = 133.33, the highest of the series.
questions.prompt: Which batsman had the highest strike rate in series S2?

explanations: Incorrect. Q totalled 600 (150+250+200).
Correct. P totalled 720 (240+180+300), above R (650), Q (600) and S (520).
Incorrect. R totalled 650 - second highest, not first.
Incorrect. S totalled only 520 - the fewest.
questions.prompt: Which batsman scored the most runs across all three series combined?

explanations: Incorrect. R's overall rate is 650/580 = 112.07% - second highest.
Incorrect. P scored the most runs but at 720/650 = 110.77% - volume is not rate.
Correct. S: 520 runs off 460 balls = 113.04%, the highest overall rate.
Incorrect. Q is the lowest at 600/570 = 105.26%.
questions.prompt: Which batsman had the highest overall strike rate across all three series?
questions.solution: 1. Overall rate = total runs / total balls. 2. P: 720/650 = 110.77%. Q: 600/570 = 105.26%. R: 650/580 = 112.07%. S: 520/460 = 113.04%. 3. Highest rate: S, which is option C. Answer C.

explanations: Incorrect. S1 totalled only 770 - the lowest, not the highest.
Incorrect. S2 totalled 850 - second to S3.
Incorrect. The totals (770, 850, 870) are all different.
questions.prompt: In which series were the most runs scored by all four batsmen combined?

sets.context:
Population (in lakh) and literacy percentage of four districts in census years 2011 and 2021:

| District | 2011 pop | 2011 lit% | 2021 pop | 2021 lit% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| N | 12 | 60 | 15 | 75 |
| S | 20 | 50 | 22 | 70 |
| E | 8 | 75 | 10 | 80 |
| W | 15 | 65 | 18 | 83 |

explanations: Incorrect. N had 15*75% = 11.25 lakh literates in 2021.
Correct. S had 22*70% = 15.40 lakh, above W (14.94), N (11.25) and E (8).
Incorrect. E had 10*80% = 8 lakh - the fewest, not the most.
Incorrect. W had 18*83% = 14.94 lakh - close second, but below S.
questions.prompt: Which district had the most literate people in 2021?

explanations: Incorrect. N rose 75-60 = 15 points - less than S.
Incorrect. E rose only 80-75 = 5 points.
Correct. S rose 70-50 = 20 points, the largest jump (N 15, W 18, E 5).
Incorrect. W rose 83-65 = 18 points - second to S.
questions.prompt: Which district recorded the largest increase in literacy rate (in percentage points) between 2011 and 2021?
questions.solution: 1. N: 15. S: 20. E: 5. W: 18. 2. Largest is S with 20 points, which is option C. Answer C.

explanations: Incorrect. W added 14.94-9.75 = 5.19 lakh - just short of S.
Incorrect. N added 11.25-7.20 = 4.05 lakh.
Incorrect. E added only 8-6 = 2 lakh.
Correct. S added 15.40-10 = 5.40 lakh, the most (W 5.19, N 4.05, E 2).
questions.prompt: Which district added the most literate people (in absolute numbers) between the two censuses?
questions.solution: 1. 2011 literates: N 7.2, S 10, E 6, W 9.75 (lakh). 2. Added: N 4.05, S 5.40, E 2.00, W 5.19. 3. Most is S, which is option D. Answer D.

explanations: Correct. E had 8*75% = 6 lakh literates in 2011, below N (7.2), W (9.75) and S (10).
Incorrect. N had 12*60% = 7.2 lakh.
Incorrect. S had 20*50% = 10 lakh - the most, not the fewest.
Incorrect. W had 15*65% = 9.75 lakh.
